name: Cleric
resourceDesc: Grace, a well of a hundred, pays for every prayer; it comes back steadily, faster for a heal that wastes nothing.
identity: A lay-sister or lay-brother of a hill shrine, outside the Concord: mend, ward and censure by the lantern's light. GAME-ONLY (no priests or clerics in canon).

branches.name: Lantern
branches.loop: Mend the one in danger, lay a Vigil on the tank, and let Long Mend land on the spike.
branches.tradeoff: Long Mend is slow; a spike that lands first is not undone.

nodes.name: Steady Hand
nodes.desc: Mend heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Long Vigil
nodes.desc: Vigil lasts 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Thrift of Grace
nodes.desc: A heal that wastes nothing refunds 3 Grace per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Prayer
nodes.desc: Long Mend casts 0.2s faster per rank.

nodes.name: Lantern Light
nodes.desc: Your next Mend after a Vigil is instant (rank 2: and heals 10% more).

nodes.name: Keeper of the Flame
nodes.desc: Once a fight, a party member who would fall is held at 1 and healed 30%.

nodes.name: Trimmed Wick
nodes.desc: Mend and Long Mend cost 1 less Grace per rank.

nodes.name: Lamp Held Low
nodes.desc: Mend and Long Mend heal 5% more on someone under 35% health.

branches.name: Choir
branches.loop: Litany heals all near you; hold the Hymn while the party takes spread damage.
branches.tradeoff: Every heal is round you: the far ones wait.

nodes.name: Full Voice
nodes.desc: Litany heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Wide Ring
nodes.desc: Litany and Hymn reach 1 m further per rank.

nodes.name: Held Note
nodes.desc: Hymn channels 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Answering Voice
nodes.desc: Hymn refunds 2 Grace a tick per rank.

nodes.name: Sanctuary
nodes.desc: A circle where the party takes 5% less per rank.

nodes.name: The Whole Chorus
nodes.desc: Litany also heals for 30% more over 6s.

nodes.name: Even Breath
nodes.desc: Litany costs 2 less Grace per rank.

nodes.name: Answering Hills
nodes.desc: Each tick of the Hymn mends the most hurt within its reach for 5% more.

branches.name: Censure
branches.loop: Brand the foe, Rebuke it, and spend the Brands on Sunburst.
branches.tradeoff: A Brand let fall is Grace spent for nothing.

nodes.name: Hard Word
nodes.desc: Rebuke deals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Deep Brand
nodes.desc: Brand burns 1 tick longer per rank.

nodes.name: Stern Voice
nodes.desc: Rebuke casts 0.15s faster per rank.

nodes.name: Sunburst
nodes.desc: Sunburst consumes Brands for 20% more per rank.

nodes.name: Witness
nodes.desc: Branded foes take 3% more from the party per rank.

nodes.name: Last Judgement
nodes.desc: Sunburst on a foe under 25% deals double.

nodes.name: Burning Word
nodes.desc: Brand burns 3% harder per rank.

nodes.name: Ashes Returned
nodes.desc: Sunburst gives back 2 Grace for each Brand it spends.

branches.name: Warden
branches.loop: Ward the one who will be hit, Absolve the cursed, and stand in Steadfast.
branches.tradeoff: A ward on the wrong one is a heal wasted.

nodes.name: Thick Ward
nodes.desc: Ward absorbs 5% more per rank.

nodes.name: Quick Absolution
nodes.desc: Absolve's cooldown is 2s shorter per rank.

nodes.name: Steadfast
nodes.desc: Steadfast's aura cuts 1% more per rank.

nodes.name: Renewing Ward
nodes.desc: A broken Ward heals 4% of its strength per rank.

nodes.name: Shared Ward
nodes.desc: Ward also lands on one more ally per rank, at half strength.

nodes.name: Bulwark of Faith
nodes.desc: Once a fight, the party is warded for 20% of its health.

nodes.name: Patient Ward
nodes.desc: Ward lasts 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: The Shrine Holds
nodes.desc: While Steadfast stands, Ward absorbs 5% more.
